provenance: generation-attempts.json retains exact prompt/reference hashes, actual built-in result metadata and verbatim raw copies; helper pose/history JSON retains selections and prior registrations; row/figure crop provenance is recorded.
remaining_limits: Human motion acceptance, browser playback and Godot/editor/runtime checks remain with the parent; none were performed here.
Static frame sheets establish inspected drawings and source order, not continuous animation smoothness or original per-frame timing. Preview GIFs/libraries use 10fps review timing.

Separately redrawn contours, small material details and apparent volume vary between frames. The prescribed uniform aspect-fit/source-box registration is retained; no independent per-pose scaling correction or motion warping was applied.

Offline rebuilding of existing isolated artwork uses the repository helper, generation plan and original reference tree with Python/Pillow. No offline drawing model, weights, seeds or deterministic cloud redraw is supplied.
Final commercial/redistribution entitlement for third-party reference material is not established by this asset work.
